description: This file declares a module `resolveCwd` that provides functions to resolve module paths relative to the current working directory, mimicking `require.resolve`. It includes two functions: a standard resolver that throws if not found, and a silent version that returns undefined instead of throwing.

methods.name: resolveCwd
methods.description: Function resolving a module path like `require.resolve()` but from the current working directory.

methods.name: resolveCwd.silent
methods.description: Silent version of resolveCwd that returns undefined if the module can't be found.
